title: Rajasthan Desert Festival
description: Enjoy folk performances, camel races, and colorful cultural shows under starlit skies in the golden dunes of the Thar Desert.
highlights: Sam Sand Dunes Folk Fire Dance & Kalbeliya Music
Royal Turban Tying & Mr. Desert Pageant

title: Kerala Backwaters Weekend
description: Serene escape into the lush green palm landscapes, tranquil lagoons, and traditional snake-boat rhythms of God's Own Country.
highlights: Private Houseboat Lake Cruise with Live Chef
Organic Spice Garden Walk and Ayurvedic Tea Tasting

title: Pushkar Camel Fair
description: A world-renowned vibrant gathering featuring decorated camel parades, hot air ballooning, sacred lake ghat aarti, and Rajasthani folk arts.
highlights: Hot Air Balloon Dawn Sunrise Flight Over Fairgrounds
Pushkar Lake Evening Maha Aarti with 108 Lamps
Handicraft Leather and Silver Jewelry Bazaars

title: Rann Utsav White Desert Festival
description: Ethereal endless salt flats shimmering under the full moon, royal tent city luxury, Kutchi embroidery, and soulful Sufi melodies.
highlights: Full Moon White Desert Camel Cart Ride
Artisan Rogan Painting & Bandhani Weaving Workshops
